replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
This is addressed to both of you together, because the outcome turns on a point neither of you controls.

On the merits of the charge, the driver is right. POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs: EV-TRIP-00207 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 06:41:20; EV-GPS-00207 puts the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD pickup geofence from 06:41:10, ten seconds before that event; the driver then held position continuously for 507 seconds, against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (measured, correctly, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap); and the trip was terminated by the driver at 06:49:37 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 207 seconds after the required dwell ran out at 06:46:10. The rider's account that he 'came down a few minutes late' is not borne out by his own telemetry: EV-GPS-00207 places the rider's device a mean 1,900 m from the pin for the whole window, with zero rider fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius.

The rider's claims are therefore answered as follows. POL-NS-02 is accepted — 52 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes, closest approach 14.5 m, far beyond the three the clause requires. POL-NS-05 is accepted — the arrival marker lands on a stationary in-geofence fix, so it is not false and the waiting clock was correctly started. POL-NS-06 is accepted — a 507-second dwell against a 300-second minimum is a surplus, not a shortfall, so no full-refund route opens. POL-NS-03 is accepted — that clause is confined to a driver stationary outside the arrival radius; this driver was inside it, so there is no wrong-entrance case and no 50% goodwill payment. POL-NS-04 is accepted — the chat log contains no locating or coordinating message from the rider, and the rider's track affirmatively fails the presence limb, so the rider-contact exoneration cannot run. POL-NS-08 is accepted — the $4.00 cancellation line equals the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee ($4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee ($4.00), so there is no fare integrity defect and no basis for a PARTIAL_REFUND.

The case does not end there, and this is the part that decides it. The driver's own 30-day record trips the anti-farming guard in POL-NS-07, on both limbs: no_show_terminations_30d is 7 (the threshold is 4 or more) and 7 divided by 61 completed trips is 11.5% (the threshold is above 8%). Both parties' POL-NS-07 claims are accepted, and POL-GEN-02 confirms the driver profile is a clean artifact at weight 1.0, so there is no discount to apply. Because the guard trips, the driver's 80% compensation ($3.20) is WITHHELD and the case must escalate to a human reviewer under POL-NS-09(d). POL-NS-07 also obliges the escalation packet to instruct the reviewer to refund the rider's $4.00 fee in full, so that the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved.

Escalation is terminal for the automated pipeline (POL-GEN-03): I issue no monetary ruling today, both money figures are null, and the $4.00 sits on hold — payment_status PENDING, nothing collected and nothing refunded — until the review is done. The one open question for the reviewer, which belongs here rather than in the referrals list, is whether the driver's 7 no-shows in 30 days reflect genuine fee-farming (which would confirm the full refund of the rider's $4.00) or the ordinary pattern of a high-volume airport-run driver. The rider's own profile figures are context only and cannot settle it in either direction.

For completeness on weight: EV-ADVIS-00207-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT). The driver disclosed that impairment, and it bears no fact here — the 507-second hold is a single unbroken qualifying run, so nothing needed the advisory-based accumulation in POL-NS-06(i), and the missing advisory neither exonerates nor condemns anyone.
referrals: POL-NS-07 — the escalation packet must direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full; the fee remains on hold (fare_breakdown.payment_status PENDING) and is neither collected nor refunded pending that review.
